_source: Verbatim Thai i18n keys from pototype/pr-list.jsx PRList (L54-267) + PR_TYPES (L3-9) + the ds.jsx STATUS labels (L84-92) the prototype's <StatusBadge> renders. Kept in .json (the i18n-guard hook skips .json) so Thai never appears in the .tsx/.ts source — same pattern as boq-strings.json / vendor-strings.json. navPr is the 'ใบขอซื้อ (PR)' nav_i18n label (tn, NAV-ROUTES.md L29). Every other value is a phrases key (tp) that has no dedicated dict key — the rest of the screen uses pr.list.* / common.* / vendor.* / nav.sec.proc DICT keys via t(). typeClear (เคลียร์เงินทดรอง) is included for completeness though the wire never yields it (pr_type has 4 values; clear maps to advance on write, pr.ts PR_TYPE_MAP). All confirmed present in i18n-full.json phrases/nav_i18n.
